videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript about SK Ocean Plant stock outlook. The requirements are:
1. Respond ONLY in Korean (no English at all)
2. Around 500 characters
3. 3-5 sentences summarizing key points
4. The content is about SK Group's renewable energy restructuring and SK Ocean Plant stock analysis
Key points from the transcript:
SK Ocean Plant stock rose 11% to 16,160 won with 9x normal trading volume
SK Group announced 1.8 trillion won renewable energy restructuring with KKR
SK Ocean Plant is expected to benefit directly from this restructuring
The company is also undergoing stake sale procedures (M&A momentum)
Technical analysis suggests strong rebound but trend still uncertain
Video targets three types of viewers: those with bad positions, those wanting sell points, and new entrants
I need to write this in Korean only, around 500 characters, in 3-5 sentences.
